title: PhysiCalWorld: In-Context Physics Calibration for World Models
one_line_judgement: 值得继续观察：据摘要（arXiv 2610.30125，abs 页 Comments 为 'Project page: this https URL'，S…
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.30125，abs 页 Comments 为 'Project page: this https URL'，Subjects 为 cs.RO/cs.AI/cs.CV）：PhysiCalWorld 处理的是一个很干净的世界模型缺口——'these observations may not reveal the physics properties that determine transition dynamics, such as an object's mass distribution, joint damping, or surface friction'，结果是 'predictions tend to regress toward an empirical prior and induce severe drift in novel test scenes'。诊断很准确：新场景里模型不是算错，而是滑回先验。方法上有两个约束值得记：'calibrates action-conditioned world models to the instance-specific dynamics via in-context prompting, without fine-tuning or analytical physics modeling'——不微调、不做解析物理建模，只靠 in-context；实现方式是 'encodes an exploratory interaction clip collected within the test scene into a compact physics descriptor token'，然后 'grounded subsequent predictions in the scene's actual physical behavior'。训练侧 'trained end-to-end with the latent prediction loss alone, without physics labels'——这是最漂亮的一点：只有潜空间预测损失，没有任何物理标注，通常这类工作需要标质量/摩擦/阻尼，工程成本极高。推理侧成本也交代了：'the descriptor token is extracted once and can be reused across rollouts with negligible compute overhead'，一次性提取、跨 rollout 复用。还有一条外推性证据：'The learned descriptors also form a physically structured latent space and generalize beyond the physics ranges seen during training'——潜空间有物理结构且可外推到训练范围之外。证据边界：'We evaluate PhysiCalWorld across four environments covering diverse physics variations and show that it substantially improves rollout prediction accuracy and visual planning success rate'——四个环境，全部定性表述（substantially / improves），零个数字、零个提升幅度、四个环境名称未列；未与需要物理标注的强基线做对照（这一点摘要未提，属重要空白）。项目页：abs 页 'this https URL' 占位未展开，github.com 网页今日从本机不可达，待核验/暂无。价值路由：这条'用一次性探索片段压成 descriptor token、零物理标注训练'是 agentic-world-modeling 方向的一个低成本范式，可迁移的抽象是——当目标场景存在未被观测到的隐变量时，先花一次探索把它压成一个可复用的条件向量，而不是为每个场景重新训练或做解析建模。趋势雷达连续观察。
